Name: UnitedHealth Group Incorporated
Description: UnitedHealth Group Incorporated is a leading American multinational managed healthcare and insurance company headquartered in Minnetonka, Minnesota. As of 2020, it stands as the largest insurance company by net premiums and the second-largest healthcare company by revenue, generating $257.1 billion. The company operates primarily through its UnitedHealthcare division, which accounts for approximately 80% of its total revenue. With a diversified portfolio of health care products and services, UnitedHealth Group is well positioned to capitalize on the evolving healthcare landscape and continues to innovate in areas such as digital health and telemedicine.
